source: Architect's drawing set 'SON BEDROOM-Binder1.pdf', sheet FX-0001 'DOSTI MEZZO 16TH FLOOR', dated 20.05.2026 (kept outside the repository). Values marked derived were measured from the drawing's own scale, not read from a dimension string.

conflicts: Plan (page 1) dimensions the wardrobe front 2'-11", 2'-11", 3'-1" (WARDROBE=9'0"RFT = 9'0"); elevation 3 (page 5) shows three bays of 2'-11" (8'-9"). Page 4 gives the carcass as 9' = 2" + 3 x 2'-10" + 2 x 1" + 2", so 2'-11" is the bay pitch (2'-10" clear + a 1" partition).
Shutter width uses elevation 3 (the wardrobe's own drawing): 2'-11" / 2 = 1'-5½" = 0.4445 m. If the shutters fill only the 2'-10" clear bay on page 4 they would be 1'-5" (0.4318 m), 1.3 cm less.
